# inst/extdata

This directory contains example spatial output files generated by the `pollinatorSDM` workflow.

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `pred_prob_suitability.tif` | Continuous habitat suitability raster (0–1, Random Forest probabilities) |
| `pred_suitability.tif` | Binary suitability raster (threshold = Youden index) |

These files are provided as reference outputs for the vignette and can be loaded with:

```r
library(terra)
suitability <- terra::rast(
  system.file("extdata/pred_prob_suitability.tif", package = "pollinatorSDM")
)
```
